text:
ana_cs: Quick flag — a provisioning flap impacted ~14 trial tenants created between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-03. Im drafting an outbound note and need decisions on credits, an office-hours walkthrough, and whether to escalate any renewal-risk accounts.

reza: How many of the 14 are high-touch / sales-owned?

ana_cs: High-touch list in the sheet: https://redwood.internal/cs/impacted_june_provs — top ones: DataSage, PixelPark, Scriptly.

ops_lead: Short RCA from infra: an unexpected burst of webhook retries coincided with a worker GC pause which allowed retry queue growth and exposed a race where index creation could timeout. We pushed a guard and replayed the backlog.

ops-bot: deploybot: hotfix/guard-replay-2026-06-04 deployed by @ops_lead at 2026-06-04T03:22Z :white_check_mark:

ana_cs: I need a customer-facing RCA paragraph (1-2 sentences) to paste in the email — no internals.

sam_ml: Draft for email: "A temporary processing surge caused delays in setting up a small number of trial accounts. Our team deployed a fix, completed replay of the affected setups, and verified affected tenants are now available. We apologize for the disruption and are taking steps to prevent recurrence."

ae_jordan: Please add an explicit offer for 30-min 1:1 help for the three high-touch customers and automatic credit details.

ana_cs: Proposed compensation: automatic 20% credit applied to next invoice for trials that experienced >6 hours of provisioning delay. Offer 30-min 1:1 for top three. Thoughts?

reza: 20% sounds reasonable. I'll flag DataSage + PixelPark as renewal-risk and ping their AEs.

ops_lead: Monitoring changes: added a watchdog for long-running index creation and increased retry jitter. Also adding a dashboard to track provisioning latency percentiles.

ana_cs: Jules from ops is scheduling a 45-min office hours (technical walkthrough + live Q&A) next Thu 10am PT — will share RSVP. We'll include a 2-question survey after for feedback.

ops-bot: calendarbot: office-hours event created by @jules for 2026-06-10T17:00Z — RSVP form: https://redwood.internal/events/oh-2026-06-10

ae_jordan: AE owners notified for flagged accounts. Ill offer the 1:1 and join the office hours for the handoff.

ana_cs: Action list: reza  finalize credit mechanics and confirm which trials meet >6h threshold; jules  share office-hours invite + RSVPs; ops_lead  confirm replay/backfill completion ETA; ae_jordan  AE outreach + renewal flags. I'll post the final customer note here once credit wording is confirmed.

ops_lead: Backfill at ~80% now, ETA ~40m. Will update when done.

ana_cs: If backfill slips we extend the credit window and offer additional 1:1 troubleshooting sessions. Thanks team.
